bio.text: According to his campaign website, Jerry Carl is running for Congress in Alabama's First District.
He represented Alabama's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House from 2021 to 2025, and is a Republican candidate for the district in 2026.

According to his campaign website, he was born in Mobile, started his first company at age 25, and has started more than ten companies in fields including real estate, healthcare, timber and manufacturing.
His campaign says he ran for the Mobile County Commission and has 8 years of local government experience and 4 years at the federal level.
